props.description: The days' values; days without one stay empty.
props.name: values

props.description: The first day shown (`YYYY-MM-DD`); the earliest value's day by default.
props.name: start

props.description: The last day shown; the latest value's day by default.
props.name: end

props.description: The chart's accessible name, such as "Orders per day, this year".
props.name: label

props.description: How values are written; plain numbers in the locale by default.
props.name: valueFormat

props.description: The colour the shades are mixed from; the first step of the accent ramp by default.
props.name: color

props.description: The first day of each week column, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday); the locale's by default.
props.name: weekStart

props.description: Shows the "Less … More" scale; on by default.
props.name: showLegend

props.description: Classes for the figure, such as a width or margin.
props.name: className
